caption: A hockey puck slides along the ice, hits the metal goalpost, and deflects off at an angle.

sa.check: A hockey puck slides along the ice.
It deflects off at an angle and slides on.
The goalpost is visible where the puck meets it.
The slide comes first and the deflection follows.

pc.expect: The puck turns at the post, leaving on a new line away from it, a little slower than it arrived.
pc.fail: The puck changes direction before it reaches the post; or it leaves the post quicker than it arrived; or it carries on straight past the post's line unchanged.

pc.expect: The puck stays outside the post and the post stays fixed where it stands.
pc.fail: The puck passes through the goalpost; or it sinks into the post and comes out the other side; or the post drifts away across the ice with nothing else touching it.

pc.expect: The puck stays flat on the ice through the contact and afterwards.
pc.fail: The puck lifts off the ice and stays in the air after the deflection; or it hovers above the surface as it slides; or it sinks into the ice.

pc.expect: The puck stays a hard rigid disc and the post stays rigid metal at the contact.
pc.fail: The puck squashes or bends at the post; or the post bends and stays bent; or the puck sticks to the post.

pc.expect: One puck and one goal frame are there throughout.
pc.fail: The puck vanishes at the post or a second one appears; or the puck turns into another object at the deflection; or part of the goal frame disappears.

pc.expect: The puck's colour, the goal's paint and the ice markings stay the same.
pc.fail: The puck changes colour at the contact; or the goal frame changes colour between frames; or the lines painted in the ice shift.
